1.explanation:
1. We render two <Tabs> components: one with `type="container"` to produce the contained (box) style, and one default for the line style.
2. Each <Tab> receives:
   • renderIcon: the Carbon icon component (20×20 px by default).  
   • iconOnly: a boolean flag we introduce to switch the Tab into its icon-only variant.  
   • label: still provided for accessibility (aria-label fallback).
3. In the accompanying SCSS (IconOnlyTabs.scss), we target the new `.icon-only` modifier on the tab items to set:
   • width: 48px;  
   • center the icon;  
   • hide the text label visually.  

This reproduces the bug scenario: no text is shown, each tab is a 48px square, and the selected tab in the line variant shows the bottom border, while the contained variant shows the filled background. Detailed CSS for the `.iconOnly` modifier would follow Carbon’s conventions (`&--icon-only`, etc.) to apply the sizing and hide the label.
1.bug_scenario: The request is to update both line-style Tabs and contained (box) style Tabs so that they can be rendered in an icon-only variant. In the provided design mocks: • Each tab is a fixed 48px wide container, with the icon centered (20px icon size). • The first image shows a contained Tabs variant (“Contained icon only”) where each tab has a filled background. • The second shows the default line Tabs variant (“Line – icon only”) with only a bottom border on the selected tab. No text labels appear in either variant—only the icons are visible. All spacing and sizing follows the 48px container and 20px icon spec.
